description: Search the team's folders (by name or description), assets (by title) and feedback (by text) at once, when you don't know where something is; to browse a known folder use contents, for one asset's feedback feedback_list, for the latest feedback recent_activity. query matches case-insensitively anywhere in the text. Always returns all three categories, most recent first, each capped at limit (not paged), only items you can view; team names the team searched. Folder hits: id, name, description, parent_folder_id, url. Asset hits have the contents item shape (asset_id, version_id = its current version, version_count, media fields, url, version_url). Feedback hits are top-level comments as a plain-text preview with id, asset_id = the version it was left on, and url; feedback_get(id) has the full body and thread.

query.description: Text to search for, matched case-insensitively anywhere in a name, title or comment

team_id.description: Team to act in: the team.id an earlier result named. Omit for the team selected in the Flask app (which the user can switch at any time).

name: search
title: Search folders, assets and feedback
